layout.frame: x aft from nose tip, y right, z up, fuselage centerline z=0 [m]

wing.note: unswept quarter-chord line; incidence puts the fuselage level at loiter; washout linear root->tip, airfoil lofted linearly root->tip

cg.note: balance the finished aircraft so the CG falls in this range (slide the battery)

gear.nose_gear_model: printed PETG nose leg 8.0 mm + fork
gear.note: takeoff technique: stance; main gear at 15 deg tip-back behind the aft CG

bay_contents.note: CG budget assumes the bay contents' centroid at the bay centre; the battery slides +/- battery_slide to trim

servos.location: wing, at the aileron inboard end
fuselage bay (cables to both main wheels)

inputs.name: field_elevation_m
inputs.source: Set to your flying field elevation (ISA)

inputs.name: isa_temp_offset_K
inputs.source: Hot day ISA+15 K (30 C at sea level): lower density -> conservative takeoff/climb

inputs.name: climb_altitude_m
inputs.source: 400 ft AGL recreational ceiling

inputs.name: min_roc_ms
inputs.source: 14 CFR 23.65 (pre-amdt 64): all-engine ROC >= 300 ft/min

inputs.name: min_climb_gradient
inputs.source: 14 CFR 23.65 (pre-amdt 64): climb gradient >= 1:12

inputs.name: climb_rate_target_ms
inputs.source: Operational climb rate (~500 ft/min) for go-arounds, gusts and autopilot authority; stricter than the 300 ft/min regulatory minimum. Sizes the throttle cap

inputs.name: throttle_cap_margin
inputs.source: Thrust margin over the binding takeoff/climb requirement when sizing the throttle cap

inputs.name: v_min_ratio
inputs.source: Loiter/climb speeds >= 1.2 V_stall (14 CFR 23 speed margins; Raymer Ch.17)

inputs.name: v_liftoff_ratio
inputs.source: Raymer Sec. 17.8: V_TO = 1.1 V_stall

inputs.name: rotation_time_s
inputs.source: Raymer Sec. 17.8: ~1 s rotation for small aircraft

inputs.name: v_touchdown_ratio
inputs.source: Raymer Sec. 17.9: V_TD = 1.15 V_stall

inputs.name: k_lipo
inputs.source: Use 80% of LiPo capacity (cell health + reserve)

inputs.name: k_liion
inputs.source: Use 85% of Li-ion capacity (cutoff ~3.0 V/cell + reserve)

inputs.name: mu_roll_pavement
inputs.source: Raymer Table 17.1 dry concrete/asphalt rolling friction 0.03-0.05

inputs.name: mu_grass_ref
inputs.source: Soft-grass rolling friction of the REFERENCE wheel below (Raymer Table 17.1 soft turf 0.07, raised for small RC wheels). Other wheels scale by Bekker compaction resistance. MEASURE: tow test (luggage-scale pull / weight) with TWO wheel sizes -> gives mu_grass_ref AND bekker_n

inputs.name: grass_ref_wheel_d_m
inputs.source: Reference wheel for mu_grass_ref: Du-Bro 200SL (2 in)

inputs.name: grass_ref_wheel_w_m
inputs.source: Reference wheel width (200SL)

inputs.name: grass_ref_wheel_load_n
inputs.source: Reference wheel load (one main wheel of the v1 design)

inputs.name: bekker_n
inputs.source: Bekker soil-deformation exponent n (Bekker 1962; Wong, Theory of Ground Vehicles, Table 2.3: loams ~0.5-1.1). Rolling resistance ~ W^(1/(2n+1)) b^(-1/(2n+1)) D^(-(n+1)/(2n+1))

inputs.name: mu_brake_pavement
inputs.source: Raymer Table 17.1 braking, dry concrete 0.3-0.5 (low end: small drag brakes may not reach wheel lock). MEASURE: braked tow test

inputs.name: mu_brake_grass
inputs.source: Raymer Table 17.1 braking, soft turf / wet grass 0.2. MEASURE

inputs.name: brake_delay_s
inputs.source: Raymer Sec. 17.9: free roll before the brakes act (~1 s small aircraft, 3 s large)

inputs.name: rollout_crow
inputs.source: Crow on the landing rollout: FC raises both ailerons (flaps stay down) - drag + lift dump put more weight on the braked wheels

inputs.name: crow_aileron_up_deg
inputs.source: Aileron up-deflection for crow (further limited by NeuralFoil confidence)

inputs.name: n_crit
inputs.source: XFOIL e^N transition, 9 = standard clean conditions; printed skins/turbulence may be lower

inputs.name: roughness_k_m
inputs.source: Printed LW-PLA surface; cf. Raymer Table 12.4 (camouflage paint 1.0e-5 m)

inputs.name: re_transition_A
inputs.source: Prandtl-Schlichting mixed laminar/turbulent Cf, transition Re_x = 5e5

inputs.name: q_fuselage
inputs.source: Raymer Sec. 12.5.5 interference factor, fuselage

inputs.name: q_nacelle
inputs.source: Raymer Sec. 12.5.5: nacelle mounted directly on wing

inputs.name: q_tail
inputs.source: Raymer Sec. 12.5.5: conventional tail 1.04-1.05

inputs.name: q_gear
inputs.source: Gear mutual/airframe interference

inputs.name: dq_wheel
inputs.source: Raymer Table 12.5: regular wheel and tire, D/q per frontal area

inputs.name: dq_flat_leg
inputs.source: Raymer Table 12.5: flat spring gear leg

inputs.name: dq_round_strut
inputs.source: Raymer Table 12.5: round strut or wire

inputs.name: leak_protub_frac
inputs.source: Leakage + protuberances (FPV camera, pitot, antennas), Raymer Sec. 12.5 few % of parasite

inputs.name: re_tip_min
inputs.source: Wing-tip chord Reynolds number at loiter >= 70k: below the ~7e4 critical Re, laminar separation stops reattaching and section data/stall become unreliable (Lissaman 1983, Annu. Rev. Fluid Mech. 15)

inputs.name: wing_taper
inputs.source: Starting / screening taper ratio (Raymer Sec. 4.3.4: 0.45 is near-elliptic). The final optimizer stage chooses taper within wing_taper_bounds (5th design variable)

inputs.name: wing_taper_bounds
inputs.source: Taper range the optimizer may use (tip chord / root chord); tip Reynolds number and the stall location are the constraints that actually limit it

inputs.name: tail_cht
inputs.source: Raymer Table 6.4 homebuilt horizontal tail volume coefficient

inputs.name: tail_cvt
inputs.source: Raymer Table 6.4 homebuilt vertical tail volume coefficient

inputs.name: ar_htail
inputs.source: Raymer Table 4.3 horizontal tail aspect ratio 3-5

inputs.name: taper_htail
inputs.source: Raymer Table 4.3 tail taper 0.3-0.6

inputs.name: ar_vtail
inputs.source: Raymer Table 4.3 vertical tail aspect ratio 1.3-2.0

inputs.name: taper_vtail
inputs.source: Raymer Table 4.3 tail taper 0.3-0.6

inputs.name: tail_airfoil
inputs.source: Symmetric 9% section for tails

inputs.name: engine_out_sizing
inputs.source: Size the fin/rudder so one motor at full throttle can be held at V_mc

inputs.name: vmc_ratio
inputs.source: 14 CFR 23.149: V_MC <= 1.2 V_stall

inputs.name: rudder_max_deg
inputs.source: Maximum rudder deflection (servo throw)

inputs.name: rudder_span_frac
inputs.source: Rudder height / fin height

inputs.name: foil_conf_min
inputs.source: Minimum NeuralFoil analysis confidence trusted for the deflected-rudder section: beyond it the flow separates over the rudder and XFOIL-type methods over-predict side force

inputs.name: roll_helix_min
inputs.source: Roll performance pb/2V >= 0.07 with full aileron (Gilruth, NACA Report 755, 1943) - a non-dimensional criterion, so it scales correctly to a small UAV

inputs.name: approach_speed_ratio
inputs.source: Raymer Ch.17: approach speed = 1.3 V_stall (landing config)

inputs.name: control_cf_grid
inputs.source: Aileron / flap chord fractions considered (hinge must stay ahead of the thin trailing edge)

inputs.name: elevator_cf_grid
inputs.source: Elevator chord fractions considered

inputs.name: rudder_cf_grid
inputs.source: Rudder chord fractions considered

inputs.name: aileron_max_deg
inputs.source: Aileron throw (each direction)

inputs.name: aileron_outboard_eta
inputs.source: Aileron/flaperon outboard edge (fraction of semispan)

inputs.name: flap_aileron_gap_eta
inputs.source: Gap between flap and aileron (fraction of semispan)

inputs.name: flap_max_deg
inputs.source: Maximum landing flap deflection (further limited by analysis confidence)

inputs.name: flaperon_max_droop_deg
inputs.source: Maximum flaperon droop - leaves aileron travel about the drooped position

inputs.name: elevator_max_deg
inputs.source: Elevator throw (trailing edge up)

inputs.name: elevator_span_frac
inputs.source: Elevator span / stabilizer span

inputs.name: tail_efficiency
inputs.source: Raymer Ch.16: tail dynamic-pressure ratio ~0.9 (conventional tail)

inputs.name: static_margin_min
inputs.source: Aft CG limit: static margin >= 5% MAC

inputs.name: static_margin_max
inputs.source: Forward CG limit: static margin <= 20% MAC (sizes the elevator)

inputs.name: tipback_deg
inputs.source: Raymer Ch.11: main gear >= 15 deg behind the aft CG (tip-back angle)

inputs.name: flap_servo_mass_kg
inputs.source: Extra flap servo + horn + hinges, each (2 per aircraft)

inputs.name: washout_max_deg
inputs.source: Upper bound on wing washout considered by the optimizer

inputs.name: vtail_ar_eff_factor
inputs.source: Raymer Ch.16: fin effective aspect ratio ~1.55 x geometric (fuselage/stabilizer end-plate)

inputs.name: htail_sizing
inputs.source: 'scissor': stabilizer area = smallest meeting static stability at the AFT CG and elevator control at the FORWARD CG of the computed CG band (Torenbeek/Raymer scissor plot). 'tail_volume': Raymer Table 6.4 c_HT floor + elevator (old behaviour)

inputs.name: cg_coverage_sigma
inputs.source: CG band covers +/- 2 sigma of the as-built CG scatter (95%)

inputs.name: battery_slide_m
inputs.source: Battery tray travel each way: re-balances the as-built aircraft on the bench

inputs.name: cg_balance_tol_m
inputs.source: Accuracy of finding the CG on a balancer (each way). MEASURE: repeat the balance 5x

inputs.name: component_position_tol_m
inputs.source: As-built component placement scatter (1 sigma)

inputs.name: mass_sigma_datasheet
inputs.source: 1-sigma mass scatter of datasheet parts (motors, ESCs, cells)

inputs.name: mass_sigma_estimate
inputs.source: 1-sigma mass scatter of ESTIMATE-tagged parts (until weighed)

inputs.name: mass_sigma_structure
inputs.source: 1-sigma mass scatter of printed/laminated structure (until test panels are weighed)

inputs.name: crosswind_ratio
inputs.source: 14 CFR 23.233: demonstrated 90-deg crosswind of 0.2 V_SO for takeoff/landing

inputs.name: engine_out_bank_max_deg
inputs.source: 14 CFR 23.149: V_MC with not more than 5 deg of bank toward the operating engine

inputs.name: trim_aileron_max_frac
inputs.source: Steady trim (engine-out, crosswind) may use at most 75% of aileron throw - the rest is kept for maneuvering and gusts

inputs.name: prop_solidity
inputs.source: Blade area / disk area of the APC E props (for stopped-prop drag). MEASURE from a blade outline

inputs.name: stopped_prop_dq_per_solidity
inputs.source: Raymer Sec. 12.5: stopped (not feathered) propeller D/q = 0.8 * solidity * disk area. Set the ESC to brake the motor (a free-windmilling prop has less drag, but less yaw too)

inputs.name: fus_ki_sideforce
inputs.source: DATCOM/Raymer Ch.16 wing-body interference factor K_i for fuselage side force, high wing ~1.5

inputs.name: stall_speed_weight_g_per_ms
inputs.source: Team decision 2026-11-24: 1 m/s of (trimmed, landing-config) stall speed is worth 30 g. The optimizer minimizes  mass + this x V_stall  instead of mass alone (mass alone always shrinks the wing to the fastest stall speed any constraint allows). See the stall-speed trade study

inputs.name: endurance_design_margin
inputs.source: Team decision 2026-11-24: size the loiter for the endurance requirement + 10% (45 -> 49.5 min) so the design survives a typical miss on the unmeasured inputs (avionics power, build mass, ESC efficiency)

inputs.name: stall_speed_max_ms
inputs.source: Optional hard cap on stall speed - None in the main search; used by the stall-speed trade study

inputs.name: dihedral_max_deg
inputs.source: Largest dihedral (each panel) the sizing may use; dihedral = smallest that meets the spiral requirement

inputs.name: short_period_zeta_min
inputs.source: MIL-F-8785C Level 1, Cat B: short-period damping ratio 0.30-2.0 (checked at both CG limits, loiter)

inputs.name: short_period_zeta_max
inputs.source: MIL-F-8785C Level 1, Cat B: short-period damping ratio <= 2.0

inputs.name: phugoid_zeta_min
inputs.source: MIL-F-8785C Level 1: phugoid damping ratio >= 0.04

inputs.name: dutch_roll_zeta_min
inputs.source: MIL-F-8785C Level 1, Class I, Cat B/C: Dutch-roll damping ratio >= 0.08

inputs.name: dutch_roll_zeta_omega_min
inputs.source: MIL-F-8785C Level 1, Class I, Cat B/C: Dutch-roll zeta x omega_n >= 0.15 rad/s

inputs.name: spiral_t2_min_B_s
inputs.source: MIL-F-8785C Level 1, Cat B (loiter/cruise): unstable spiral time to double amplitude >= 20 s

inputs.name: spiral_t2_min_C_s
inputs.source: MIL-F-8785C Level 1, Cat C (approach/landing): spiral time to double amplitude >= 12 s

inputs.name: roll_tau_max_B_s
inputs.source: MIL-F-8785C Level 1, Class I, Cat B: roll-mode time constant <= 1.4 s

inputs.name: roll_tau_max_C_s
inputs.source: MIL-F-8785C Level 1, Class I, Cat C: roll-mode time constant <= 1.0 s

inputs.name: balked_landing_gradient_min
inputs.source: 14 CFR 23.77(a) (pre-amdt 64): balked-landing climb gradient >= 3.3% in landing configuration

inputs.name: prop_fuselage_clearance_m
inputs.source: Prop tip to fuselage side (1 in)

inputs.name: prop_ground_clearance_m
inputs.source: Prop tip to ground on grass (2 in)

inputs.name: nose_wheel_clearance_m
inputs.source: Gap between the top of the nose wheel and the fuselage bottom (the nose wheel sits directly under the fuselage, so the fuselage must be at least nose-wheel diameter + this above the ground)

inputs.name: internal_clearance_m
inputs.source: Gap around the payload bay contents, per side

inputs.name: fuselage_packing_factor
inputs.source: Bay volume / sum of component volumes (wiring, airflow, access)

inputs.name: pi_stack_height_m
inputs.source: Pi 5 + cooler stacked above the battery tray

inputs.name: nose_length_ratio
inputs.source: Nose fairing length / fuselage equivalent diameter

inputs.name: nacelle_extra_len_m
inputs.source: Nacelle length beyond motor: ESC + fairing

inputs.name: nacelle_wall_gap_m
inputs.source: Nacelle radial clearance around motor

inputs.name: max_motor_station_frac
inputs.source: Motor station y_eng <= 0.45 b (90% semispan)

inputs.name: main_wheel
inputs.source: Main wheels (data/wheels.csv): 3 in for soft grass - lowest rolling resistance and sinkage, ~10 g/wheel more than 2 in, inside the E/Z brake fit range (see wheel trade table)

inputs.name: nose_wheel
inputs.source: Team decision 2026-11-24: 2.5 in nose wheel with 3 in mains - the nose wheel sits under the fuselage, so its diameter sets the gear height (74 mm vs 86 mm with a 3 in nose wheel)

inputs.name: wheel_brake
inputs.source: Main-wheel brakes (data/brakes.csv): cable brakes on one micro servo (~+28 g); JP Hobby electric brakes rejected (~200 g)

inputs.name: wing_constructions
inputs.source: Wing constructions the search may use. Team decision 2026-11-24: print most of the aircraft in LW-PLA, including the wing (only the carbon spar, aluminum gear strap and music-wire nose strut are not printed). Add 'foam_glass' to let the search compare a hot-wire foam core + glass skin wing again

inputs.name: wing_skin_t_m
inputs.source: Single-wall LW-PLA wing skin

inputs.name: tail_skin_t_m
inputs.source: Single-wall LW-PLA tail skin

inputs.name: fus_skin_t_m
inputs.source: LW-PLA fuselage wall

inputs.name: nacelle_skin_t_m
inputs.source: LW-PLA nacelle wall

inputs.name: wing_internal_ratio
inputs.source: Printed internal ribs/geodesic web area per wetted area. MEASURE on a printed section

inputs.name: tail_internal_ratio
inputs.source: Printed tail internal web area ratio

inputs.name: fus_frames_ratio
inputs.source: Fuselage frames/longerons mass / shell mass

inputs.name: spar_span_frac
inputs.source: Main spar tube length / span

inputs.name: spar_min_wall_m
inputs.source: Thinnest practical carbon tube wall

inputs.name: spar_min_od_m
inputs.source: Smallest spar tube OD (handling stiffness)

inputs.name: spar_depth_frac
inputs.source: Spar OD <= 85% of root airfoil thickness

inputs.name: n_limit_maneuver
inputs.source: 14 CFR 23.337 normal category limit load factor

inputs.name: gust_ude_ms
inputs.source: 14 CFR 23.341: 50 ft/s derived gust at V_C

inputs.name: factor_of_safety
inputs.source: 14 CFR 23.303 ultimate / limit

inputs.name: n_landing_limit
inputs.source: Landing limit load factor (14 CFR 23.473 >= 2.67)

inputs.name: main_gear_load_frac
inputs.source: Raymer Ch.11: nose gear carries 8-15% of weight

inputs.name: gear_plate_width_m
inputs.source: Main-gear strap width

inputs.name: main_gear_material
inputs.source: Team decision 2026-11-24: every part 3D printed or off-the-shelf -> main gear strap printed in PETG (data/materials.csv), thickness sized from the landing load. 'aluminum_6061_t6' = bent strap from stock

inputs.name: spar_from_catalog
inputs.source: Spar = lightest off-the-shelf carbon tube in data/carbon_tubes.csv that carries the load and fits the root (False = any diameter/wall, the old idealized sizing)

inputs.name: nose_gear_type
inputs.source: 'printed_petg': printed PETG leg + wheel fork (sized from the nose load, min diameter below), printed mounting/bearing blocks + steering arm, off-the-shelf bolts and axle. 'catalog': shortest off-the-shelf steerable assembly in data/nose_gear.csv (Du-Bro, 55-62 g). 'music_wire': bent wire + steering block

inputs.name: printed_nose_leg_min_d_m
inputs.source: Minimum printed nose-leg diameter: the nose sizing load is an ESTIMATE and printed legs break at layer lines (print the leg lying flat so the layers run along it)

inputs.name: printed_fork_section_m
inputs.source: Printed nose-wheel fork tine/bridge section (w x t)

inputs.name: printed_nose_mount_mass_kg
inputs.source: Printed PETG mounting/bearing blocks + steering arm for the nose leg. WEIGH

inputs.name: nose_gear_hardware_mass_kg
inputs.source: Off-the-shelf axle bolt + 4 x M3 mounting bolts/nuts

inputs.name: nose_steer_mass_kg
inputs.source: Nose gear steering block + collar

inputs.name: motor_mount_mass_kg
inputs.source: Printed/ply motor mount, each

inputs.name: spinner_mass_kg
inputs.source: Prop adapter + spinner, each

inputs.name: power_wire_kg_m
inputs.source: 16 AWG silicone wire, per conductor-metre

inputs.name: prop_mass_10in_kg
inputs.source: APC E 10 in prop mass (APC site blocks scraping). WEIGH props

inputs.name: prop_mass_exponent
inputs.source: prop mass ~ D^2.2

inputs.name: weight_growth_allowance
inputs.source: Mass growth allowance on everything except the battery (glue, paint, connectors, build variation) - standard conceptual-design practice; reduce as parts are weighed

inputs.name: avionics_power_factor
inputs.source: Multiplier on data/components.csv power draws (Pi 5 workload is the big unknown). MEASURE the avionics current on the bench

inputs.name: eta_esc
inputs.source: ESC efficiency. MEASURE on thrust stand

inputs.name: eta_bec
inputs.source: Switching BEC efficiency for avionics

inputs.name: esc_margin
inputs.source: ESC rating >= 1.1 x static full-throttle current

inputs.name: lipo_v_nom
inputs.source: LiPo nominal cell voltage

inputs.name: liion_v_nom
inputs.source: Molicel nominal cell voltage

inputs.name: lipo_sag_at_rated_v
inputs.source: Cell sag at the rated C current -> R_cell = 0.4/(C*Ah). MEASURE with charger IR

inputs.name: liion_pack_overhead_kg
inputs.source: Li-ion pack leads, XT60, wrap, balance lead

inputs.name: liion_mass_per_cell_kg
inputs.source: Nickel strip + insulator per cell

inputs.name: liion_current_derate
inputs.source: Use 60% of the cell's temperature-limited max current as continuous limit

inputs.name: lipo_current_derate
inputs.source: Use 80% of the label C-rating as continuous limit

inputs.name: endurance_min
inputs.source: Remain airborne >= 45 min with no payload (team change Nov 2026, was 30 min; flown entirely as loiter; takeoff/climb/descent time NOT credited -> conservative)

inputs.name: takeoff_roll_max_pavement_m
inputs.source: Field survey 2026-11-24: takeoff ground roll <= 75 m on the paved strip

inputs.name: takeoff_roll_max_grass_m
inputs.source: Field survey 2026-11-24: takeoff ground roll <= 80 m on soft grass

inputs.name: landing_roll_max_pavement_m
inputs.source: Field survey 2026-11-24: braked landing ground roll <= 75 m on pavement

inputs.name: landing_roll_max_grass_m
inputs.source: Field survey 2026-11-24: braked landing ground roll <= 80 m on soft grass

inputs.name: span_max_m
inputs.source: Wingspan <= 1.5 m (team limit)

inputs.name: payload_kg
inputs.source: No payload for the endurance mission

inputs.name: n_motors
inputs.source: Notional concept: twin wing-mounted props, fixed tricycle gear, high wing
